title: Monitoring Large Crowds at Paya Lebar and Tanjong Katong Complex
what_it_is: Monitoring Large Crowds at Paya Lebar and Tanjong Katong Complex

sections.label: Paya Lebar crowd guidelines and patrols
sections.summary: Police patrol Paya Lebar and Tanjong Katong areas, using CCTV and Auxiliary Police Officers to enforce against littering, public urination and prohibited smoking.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Fatimah Lateef
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Home Affairs what are the guidelines and monitoring mechanisms in place pertaining to the large congregations of persons, especially over the weekends and holidays, in the vicinity of Paya Lebar and Tanjong Katong Complex.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: They tend to gather around the Paya Lebar Mass Rapid Transit (MRT) station and nearby shopping malls, such as City Plaza, 1KM Mall and Tanjong Katong Complex.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police patrol these areas to engage the foreign workers on crime prevention messages and also advise them to abide by the law.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: Police closed-circuit television (CCTV) cameras (PolCams) are deployed at public areas to deter crime and help Police detect and respond to incidents.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: To manage social disamenities, the Police also deploy Auxiliary Police Officers (APOs) to conduct daily high visibility patrols in the vicinity of Paya Lebar MRT, Tanjong Katong Complex and City Plaza, particularly in the evenings.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The APOs take enforcement action against littering, urinating in public and smoking in prohibited places.

sections.label: Police monitor Paya Lebar crowds
sections.summary: The Police will continue to monitor closely the congregation of crowds in the vicinity of Paya Lebar.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The Police will continue to monitor closely the congregation of crowds in the vicinity of Paya Lebar.

sections.label: Manpower outreach and PolCams
sections.summary: The Ministry of Manpower reaches out to workers in foreign dormitories, and PolCams supplement Police efforts by watching large crowds.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Beyond that, the Ministry of Manpower has its outreach to workers in foreign dormitories to encourage them to understand and abide by our laws.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Supplementing the Police efforts are also PolCams that help to keep an eye over large crowds of people.
